title: Adding a Partner Tenant to Zscaler Client Connector in the Classic UI

blocks.text: This article provides information about the Classic UI version of the app available with Zscaler Client Connector versions earlier than 5.0. To learn more about the Modern UI version of the app available with Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0, see Using Zscaler Client Connector in the Modern UI.
You can add a partner tenant to the app so that you can access the partner's internal resources without needing to log out of and back in to Zscaler Client Connector.

Before you can add a partner tenant, your organization and the partner organization must enable Private Access partner logins. If you use Zscaler Client Connector version 4.6 and later for Windows or Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later for macOS, your organization can enable partner logins by app profile and for specific domains. You can enable Private Access partner logins even if you do not use Private Access and use only Internet & SaaS.
This article provides instructions on adding a partner tenant to Zscaler Client Connector based on the OS.

blocks.item: Windows
To add a partner tenant using the Windows version of Zscaler Client Connector:
Open Zscaler Client Connector and click Private Access.
See image.
If your organization does not use Private Access, the Private Access window displays only the Add Partner Tenant link and information about the partner tenant.
Click Add Partner Tenant.
The Add Tenant window appears.
Based on your organization's partner tenant settings, you are prompted to complete one of the following steps:
In the Add Tenant window, enter your username for the partner tenant and click Submit.
See image.
In the Add Tenant window:
Select the partner tenant to access and click Connect.
See image.
Enter your username for the partner tenant, and click Submit.
The identity provider page for the partner organization appears. In this example, the partner identity provider is Okta.
See image.
Enter your credentials for the partner tenant and log in.
The Private Access window reappears and displays both your organization's tenant and the partner tenant.
See image.

After logging in to the partner organization, Zscaler Client Connector automatically turns off Private Access access to your organization. You can click Turn On for the main tenant to enable it and automatically turn off access to the partner organization.
After you have added the partner tenant, the partner tenant remains on this window, and you can click Turn On for the partner tenant to enable Private Access access to the partner organization.
